label: No component is the first being, from efficient esse-causes and first-being act priority
meaning: Sibling of 358d8c6e (act priority only at a first being) in which the participated component's other cause is an efficient cause of its esse and e078f07b is applied to that efficient relation at the esse respect only, rather than to the mode-unspecified CausesIn. Every other input is unchanged. The efficiency that 358d8c6e and e7b4c683 assume in a reading step is here a premise that can fail (NonEfficientParticipationControl). No sibling of e7b4c683 is registered: its inputs a4d3261a and 86f10ec3 use two POTENCY senses without a bridge (legacy allowlist), and a new argument may not inherit that. It assumes that efficient-cause priority (e078f07b, whose claim and derivation are read for the secunda via's here-and-now relation) holds for the tenseless efficient cause of esse; that scope step is open (the tense bridge). No premise is discharged.
